article.en: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
article.zh: 我走进饭店经理的办公室，坐了下来。

article.en: I had just lost fifty pounds and I felt very upset.
article.zh: 我刚刚丢了50英镑，感到非常烦恼。

article.en: 'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now.'
article.zh: ‘我把钱放在房间里，’我说，‘可现在没有了。’

article.en: The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
article.zh: 经理深表同情，但也无能为力。

article.en: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.
He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
article.zh: 他开始抱怨起这个邪恶的世道来，却被一阵敲门声打断了。

article.en: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
article.zh: 一位姑娘走了进来，把一个信封放在了他的桌上。

article.en: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.
article.zh: ‘这是我在这位先生的房门外捡到的，’她说。

article.en: 'Well,' I said to the manager, 'there is still some honesty in this world!'
article.zh: ‘是啊，’我对那位经理说，‘这世界上还是有诚实可言的！’
